title: 彭博科技主播：苹果诉OpenAI窃密，硅谷硬件人才战升级
speaker: Ed Ludlow

segments.en: Well, I mean, this is a big story and I would say probably actually as much about Silicon Valley's look to the future of hardware as it is the people, you know, if you think
segments.zh: 这确实是个大新闻，我认为这既关乎人才，也关乎硅谷对硬件未来的布局。

segments.en: about the landscape of Apple and Meta as examples trying to work out how people consumers use AI through different device form factors, the smartphone is what we mostly use but glasses are coming in, people have tried pins, that's kind of the underlying layer of the story which
segments.zh: 以苹果和Meta为例，它们都在探索消费者如何通过不同设备形态使用AI。智能手机仍是主流，但眼镜正在兴起，还有人尝试过别针设备，这是故事的底层逻辑。

segments.en: is interesting but in terms of Apple versus open AI the sort of full economic and litigating might of Apple against open AI, it's very serious.
segments.zh: 但就苹果对OpenAI而言，苹果动用全部经济和诉讼力量，这非常严重。

segments.en: You just referenced it but what does this mean for open AI when it comes to trying to expand into hardware and when it comes to actually making money from people using AI which is a bit of a...
segments.zh: 你刚提到，这对OpenAI进军硬件以及从AI使用中盈利意味着什么？
